output.brief: The October night premium shortfalls were caused by a pay rule change, not by your data. On 22 Oct an Ardentra consultant applied a standard template to the night premium rule (NSP-02). It was logged as a label correction, but it also moved the premium start time from 20:00 to 22:00. The platform's audit trail records this and Ardentra can't edit it. Internal audit recalculated pay for all 158 night workers. 147 were underpaid, by exactly the 20:00–22:00 premium. The 11 paid correctly work 22:00–06:00. Re-running October in Ardentra's test tenant with the 20:00 start gave correct pay for all 158. Data quality, the timesheet portal, the bank file and release 7.4 don't explain it. Ardentra's account doesn't hold up. I'm very confident of this. What to do: do not suspend the HR team or reload data, and do not accept the clause 14.3 cost. Have Ardentra restore the 20:00 start, verify it in the test tenant before 24 Nov, and make off-cycle payments to everyone underpaid, including the 8 who never complained. Keep the rota trial running for now. The drop in night overtime cover has two possible causes, the pay shortfall and the rota trial. The evidence can't separate them, so review it again once pay is fixed.
